appearance.grass: dry matte realistic turf; no wet or glossy reflections
appearance.lighting: team accents in stands and roofline; restrained neutral field light
appearance.logos: canonical supplied logo artwork, solid depth and beveled edges, restrained reflections; same horizontal plane
appearance.panels: One shared Rams/Seahawks card style: angled team-color stripes, large team logo, thin shiny metallic border and dark team-name footer.
appearance.teamReplacement: Replace team colors, supplied team logo and team name. Optional record or rank uses the same layout family.
appearance.variantPolicy: Every pairing uses this one card style, including Browns/Ravens and Chiefs/Chargers. Do not reproduce the separate Browns/Ravens texture or invent a new card treatment.
appearance.fieldContact: Soft card-bound contact shadow planes lie at turf height and move with each card. They are a composited contact-shadow treatment, not a shadow-catcher simulation.

timing.entrance: Mark dialogue and same-revision Manim cues

visualReference.statement: The LA Rams and Seattle Seahawks cards are the ones that we lock in as our template.

workflow.assetGeneration: Three.js creates one reusable Rams/Seahawks-style card shell as standard PBR GLB geometry. Team colors are material inputs.
workflow.unreal: Import the GLB; add canonical logo depth, lighting, camera and smooth entrance. Hold static with no animation out.
workflow.scope: Rams-Seahawks paired-logo motion review on the shared shell. No additional team pairings or component rebuilds.
workflow.nextStep: Bind actual episode Mark dialogue and same-revision Manim entrance cues to the visually approved Rams-Seahawks baseline, then verify production handoff.
